text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek and I are returning from a
shopping
trip.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Wow, we must have lost track of time
buying all
these things. It's so late!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...What's that?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck at our
New Year's
raffle! This year's grand-prize
is a coupon for a
hot spring vacation for
two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
You two over there! Care to try your
luck?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We've already got a raffle ticket, so why
don't we
give it a shot?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: All right! Give it all you've got! ♪

Congratulations!
